text:
sam-partnerships: Heads-up — ClockBand just flagged that our marketplace shows doubled minutes for a subset of their devices this morning. looks like minute-heartbeats are being ingested twice for the same timestamp.

nina-engineering: Ack. Do we have an example payload?

sam-partnerships: Pasted a sample from their support dump: ```json
{"device_id":"cb-42","ts":"2026-03-23T09:12:00Z","usage_minutes":1,"signature":"sigabc123"}
``` They send a retry within <5s with same ts and no seq id. signature header differs (they re-signed)

carlos-bizops: That explains billing delta on today's regen. Customer-facing ledger already has +1 minute twice for ~120 devices. Need to reconcile before EOD. :grimacing: 

elaine-sre: Is this ingestion-level duplication or a downstream aggregation bug? Any chance of out-of-order fanout causing a replay?

nina-engineering: Checked the ingest logs — we got two POSTs with identical body but different request ids. Our signature verifier accepted both because we don't enforce a unique request id or sequence for partner webhooks.

ops-bot: alert: partner-duplicate-usage-detect triggered for provider=clockband, affected=3 batches, potential-credit=+2h

sam-partnerships: ClockBand says their gateway retries on sync failures and they don't send an idempotency-key. They asked if we can dedupe on our side while they patch.

carlos-bizops: We should avoid automatically crediting back until we confirm true double-bill. What is the safest immediate mitigation?

nina-engineering: Quick mitigation: dedupe at the hourly-rollup stage by collapsing identical (device_id, ts, usage_minutes) tuples within a 10s window. That will stop near-term doubles and is low-risk. I'll PR a change to the rollup job.

elaine-sre: Add a metric for "duplicate_input_count" and a small backfill that tags suspect rows so billing can optionally be ignored during invoicing.

sam-partnerships: ClockBand will add a `seq` field and an `Idempotency-Key` header in their SDK patch. They plan to push to edge gateways in 48h.

carlos-bizops: Timeline sounds good. Action list?

nina-engineering: A1: rollup dedupe rule (owner: nina) — target deploy in 3h.

elaine-sre: A2: metric + alert (owner: elaine) — target 1h.

sam-partnerships: A3: confirm partner patch + share SDK change log (owner: sam) — update in 24h.

carlos-bizops: A4: hold manual billing adjustments until a verification pass. I'll coordinate with finance for a conservative flagging flow. (owner: carlos)

ops-bot: runbook link: https://go/redwood/partner-metering/replay-dedupe-runbook

clockband-integration-bot: ClockBand response: "we will roll idempotency-key in SDK v1.2.3, pushing to gateways 48h. we will also send a reconciliation dump of suspected duplicate events."

nina-engineering: For reconciliation: can we request a CSV of (device_id, ts, seq?, request_id) — if seq missing we should use request_id and signature to map duplicates.

sam-partnerships: Already asked. They'll provide a dump and a signed manifest.

elaine-sre: Once dump arrives, we'll run a one-off dedupe/backfill job that marks duplicates and emits a "partner_dedupe_applied" flag so billing's pipeline can skip those entries for this billing cycle.

carlos-bizops: Good. Also need customer comms: short note explaining temporary discrepancy and that we're preventing double charges. Sam, can you draft?

sam-partnerships: Will draft an email and Slack blurb for their account team. Target: in 2h after we see metrics.

nina-engineering: Quick note re: long-term contract change — add required idempotency-key and optional seq in the webhook contract. Add an SLA for gateway upgrade timelines for hardware partners. I'll start a PR to the integration docs.

sam-partnerships: :thumbsup: we'll add to the partner onboarding checklist and update the SDK acceptance tests.

carlos-bizops: OK — we'll pause auto-invoicing of affected customers until we confirm dedupe. Finance looped in.

elaine-sre: After deploy, expect a small spike in CPU for rollup window while dedupe runs — I'll provision +10% headroom.

nina-engineering: Deploying the rollup change now. I'll post results in this thread.

sam-partnerships: Thanks! ping me when done and I'll notify the partner.

nina-engineering: Deployed. Duplicate count dropped to baseline. Summary: 118 duplicate events collapsed across 3 regions. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rollups/pulls/482

elaine-sre: Metrics look clean, alert cleared.

sam-partnerships: Sent partner note and internal account comms. Partner to share reconciliation CSV by EOD.

carlos-bizops: Great work. We'll reconvene tomorrow if partner dump needs manual adjustments. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
